<!-- PROTOTYPE v2 — fact sheet. Throwaway. -->

::: {.proto-facts}
Status
: [In production]{.proto-status .s-prod}

What it is
: Where you apply for access to BigPicture datasets. The dataset's data access committee (DAC) reviews your application in REMS. Once it is approved, your permission is passed on automatically to the download services.

Who it's for
: Researchers applying for data, and DAC members reviewing applications.

Provided by
: CSC

Before you start
: An [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd) login, with membership of your organisation's [Perun](perun.qmd) group.

How to get access
: Sign in at [bp-rems.sd.csc.fi](https://bp-rems.sd.csc.fi/). Find a dataset there, or through [Discovery](discovery.qmd) or the [Landing pages](landing-pages.qmd), and apply.

Guides
: - [About REMS](https://bp-rems.sd.csc.fi/extra-pages/about)
  - Guide for data requestors, guide for DAC members [(SharePoint, members)]{.text-muted}

Terms and privacy
: You accept the BigPicture Data Sharing Agreement in your application. [BigPicture privacy notice](https://bigpicture.eu/bigpicture-privacy-notice)

Support
: ::: {.proto-help}
  [servicedesk@bigpicture.eu](mailto:servicedesk@bigpicture.eu){.proto-mail}
  :::

Estimated response time
: 3 working days

Related services
: [Discovery](discovery.qmd), [Landing pages](landing-pages.qmd), [Repository](repository.qmd), [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd), [Perun](perun.qmd)

Source code
: [CSCfi/rems](https://github.com/CSCfi/rems)
:::
